config.title: DeepSeek Harness
config.url: DSH web server URL (usually the local loopback address).
config.autoStart: On VS Code startup, automatically start `dsh web` if the server is not running (falls back to `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest` when `dsh` is not found).
config.command: Command used to start the server; falls back to `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest` when not found.
config.autoStartTimeoutSec: Maximum seconds to wait when auto-starting the server.
config.participantSessionMode: Session scope for the @dsh chat participant.
config.participantSessionMode.perWorkspa: One @dsh session per project (workspace folder); multi-root workspaces follow the active editor (recommended)
config.participantSessionMode.global: All projects share a single @dsh session
config.openPanelOnStartup: Automatically open the standalone DSH chat window on VS Code startup (off by default; the primary entry is the @dsh participant in the built-in Chat).
config.defaultReasoningEffort: Thinking depth (reasoning effort, e.g. off / high / max depending on the model) applied to newly created sessions. Leave empty to use the model default; the chat window toolbar can adjust the current session at any time.
config.language: UI language of the extension (chat panel, notifications, @dsh replies).
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language (default)
